name: marketing-team-sections
title: Team Sections
description: Explore a curated collection of team section components built with Tailwind CSS. Display team member profiles with images, names, roles, and social links perfect for company websites and about pages.
useWhen: Introducing a company team, leadership group, or contributors on an about or recruiting page.
Pairing names and roles with optional bios or social profile links.
avoidWhen: Displaying a large staff directory with search and filtering — use an application directory.
The page lacks permission to publish personal images or profile information.
responsiveBehavior: Profile grids reduce to fewer columns and then a single column on small screens. Keep names and roles adjacent to their image in all layouts.
accessibility: Use descriptive alt text for a person photograph, normally their name.
Icon-only social links need accessible names that identify the destination.
Use heading levels consistently for the section and each profile name.
